summary.text: Josh Penner is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 31-Position 2 since January 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat John Bielka.

paragraphs.text: Josh Penner was born in Seattle, Washington, and his career experience includes working as an entrepreneur.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps, and he earned a graduate degree from Harvard University and a bachelor's degree from St. Martin's University in 2009.
Penner assumed office in the Washington House on January 13, 2025.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary with 55.7 percent of the vote.
